schedule_contract.qualification: Independent exact original-source static parser/callback/storage contracts; no emulator-generated expectations and no native whole-wire replay claim.

field_types_and_limits.id: Integer, stored low8; bitmap uses byte ID shift and16-bit result.
field_types_and_limits.name: String capacity32, hence maximum31 bytes. Actual generic string backend e025c64 calls bounded length at e025d0e and rejects length==capacity at e025d12/e025d14; no WB36 length assumption is used.
field_types_and_limits.enable: Integer;1 maps to internal0, every other integer to internal1. Query inverts internal1 to public0, other internal values to public1.
field_types_and_limits.tz: Integer parse required into stack+0xc, not subsequently stored in the52-byte record.
field_types_and_limits.hr: Integer low8, no native0..23 validation in this parser.
field_types_and_limits.min: Integer low8, no native0..59 validation in this parser.
field_types_and_limits.sec: Optional/error-inverted field: e01d26a..d270 stores0 on successful parse, otherwise prior integer-output scratch. Generic numeric getter e025e2e..e025e32 writes destination only on success, so missing sec retains preceding min scratch. This is a static branch consequence, not a replay observation.
field_types_and_limits.week: Read seven integer array elements and OR each value shifted by index into a byte; no boolean normalization. Extra elements are not consumed into the mask.
field_types_and_limits.cmd: Only first command object parsed. opt is a string array and p a numeric array; cmd.mac is not read. Only opt equal to literal Pow stores a power byte; absent Pow leaves zero from original record memset. Later command objects/other property names are not scheduled options.

record_parser.duration: e01d32e..d35c calls original clock helper e01f1a8 then computes target hour/min/sec minus signed remainder(epoch,86400), storing int32 at payload+0x30. Clock helper copies/converts native RTC through e01f0dc and e0b1848. Physical RTC calibration is unknown; no observed clock value is asserted for this source.
record_parser.failure: Returns-1 before copying the local record to the caller. setT/updateT ignore that return, so malformed records can cause stale/uninitialized caller-stack payload mutation; that is unsafe native behavior, not a valid fallback schema.

setT.capacity_branch: e01d4c6 compares count byte with9; count>9 returns-1 without writing a response BEFORE duplicate/upsert lookup.
setT.id_branch: Required integer id is low8 at e01d4ee. Lookup e019a8c returns-1 when found and0 when absent.
setT.state_transition: For found ID, negative lookup takes e01d514..d52e -> update wrapper e01d474 -> e0199bc; count is unchanged. For absent ID, nonnegative lookup takes e01d56e..d588 -> append wrapper e01d428 -> e019982, increments count and links a new60-byte allocation containing52-byte payload. Thus setT is UPSERT while count<10, not duplicate rejection; full count blocks even an existing-ID update.
setT.parser_result: e01d508 parser result is not checked before mutation. Calls e016fb4 and sets source dirty state via selected wrapper.

queryT.response: listT with total=source count byte,index=request index,list=array. Record fields id,name,enable,week,hr,min,sec,cmd are emitted with original string/integer constructors.
queryT.selection: e01bb0c checks loop index<=9, e01bb24..bb2c checks index-start<count, and e01bb2e truncates candidate to uint8 for lookup e019aa0. This is ID-based selection, not list ordinal pagination. Missing candidates log then continue; count0 yields an empty list.
queryT.command_readback: Always one cmd object: mac=[module MAC obtained through e023584 and lowercase six-byte hex format], opt=[Pow], p=[stored power byte]. It does not echo requested MAC, arbitrary options or second command object.
queryT.reject: Missing index/count returns-1 without response at e01baaa.

deleteT.state_transition: e0199f0 decrements count byte at e0199f2..99f8 BEFORE searching the list. Missing ID returns-1 from helper but callback ignores it and ACKs200, allowing count underflow/wrap independently of list length. Found ID clears active and selected Pow bitmap bits, unlinks and frees node. Callback sets0x42 at1002cc06+4 and calls e016fb4.

updateT.fields: Same exact record_parser, including sec and malformed-parser quirks
updateT.state_transition: Always invokes replacement wrapper e01d474 -> e0199bc. Replaces52-byte payload for matching ID; missing ID returns without inserting. Count does not increment. Parser return is ignored. Dirty flag and e016fb4 execute independent of lookup success.
